title: Sennacherib besieges Lachish
summary: Sennacherib besieges Lachish while dealing with Hezekiah (2 Kings 18:14, 17; 19:8).
description: Sennacherib besieges Lachish while dealing with Hezekiah (2 Kings 18:14, 17; 19:8). Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 713, pp. 44–45; section “Confirmation from the Lachish Reliefs”, p. 27).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 713 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 713, pp. 44–45; section “Confirmation from the Lachish Reliefs”, p. 27
chronologies.note: Part of Sargon’s Ashdod campaign, Sennacherib as crown prince (MAN, vice-regent) before Sargon on the Lachish reliefs.
